Very disappointing experience from start to finish. From the get go, I felt like they were looking for any reason to pick apart my trade in and justify offering me as little as possible. They repeatedly questioned me about my vehicle’s payoff amount before we had even reached a deal, which I found unnecessary and intrusive.

It felt like they wanted top dollar for their inventory while offering bottom dollar for trades. The entire interaction left a bad taste in my mouth, and I felt my time was completely wasted.

I wouldn’t do business here or recommend this dealership based on my experience.

reviewReply.comment: Hi Amanda, we're sorry your experience with us wasn't what you expected or what we strive to provide. We asked about your payoff because we were working to show you accurate payments on the new vehicle, and we can't calculate that correctly without knowing what's owed on your trade. Because we appraised your Yukon remotely, our offer also had to account for items we weren't able to confirm in person, for example the recent engine oil consumption check that was cited when we checked the carfax. Without being able to inspect these high risk items in person we need to account for the risks to the next owner. We'd still welcome the chance to see your Yukon in person and take another look at the numbers.
